meta.name: elevenlabs-dubbing
meta.description: ElevenLabs automatic dubbing - translate and dub audio/video into 29 languages while preserving speaker voice via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: auto speaker detection, voice-preserving translation, video dubbing, audio localization. Use for: content localization, video translation, multilingual content, international distribution. Triggers: dubbing, dub video, translate audio, video translation, audio translation, localize content, elevenlabs dubbing, eleven labs dub, multilingual dub, voice translation, auto dub, language dub, content localization

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将音视频自动翻译并配音成29种语言，保留原声
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将音视频内容快速翻译并配音成多种语言
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly translate and dub audio/video content into multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用 ElevenLabs 自动配音工具，将音频或视频翻译并配音成 29 种语言，同时保留原说话人的声音特征。
howto.when: 当你要求配音、翻译音频或视频、本地化内容，或提到“elevenlabs dubbing”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个英文视频配音成西班牙语。
say.note: Claude 会调用配音工具处理视频链接。

say.text: 将这段播客音频翻译成法语并配音。
say.note: Claude 会处理音频文件并输出配音结果。

say.text: 把这个视频同时配音成日语、韩语和中文。
say.note: Claude 会依次执行多次配音任务。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use the ElevenLabs automatic dubbing tool to translate and dub audio/video into 29 languages while preserving the original speaker's voice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to dub, translate audio/video, localize content, or mention keywords like "elevenlabs dubbing".

say_en.text: Dub this English video into Spanish.
say_en.note: Claude will process the video link with the dubbing tool.

say_en.text: Translate this podcast audio to French and dub it.
say_en.note: Claude will handle the audio file and output the dubbed result.

say_en.text: Dub this video into Japanese, Korean, and Chinese simultaneously.
say_en.note: Claude will run multiple dubbing tasks sequentially.
